_derivation.note: official_fields.json is produced by build_official_fields.py (committed alongside, deterministic) from the machine-readable OpenAPI spec (pinterest/api-description, pinned 5.28.0): the column space is the ReportingColumnAsync enum (626 values) UNION the single sync-only column QUIZ_PIN_RESULT_OPEN (627 official columns total), plus the ONE structural grain dimension of the report response ('date' <- the DATE response key at granularity DAY; never sent in the request's columns array) -> 628 catalog entries. Entity-attribute columns (CAMPAIGN_NAME, AD_GROUP_STATUS, PRODUCT_ITEM_*, ...; the 53 Annex A [dim] markers) are declared kind=dimension; everything else kind=metric.
_derivation.expansion_rule: NO expansion needed: unlike Meta action-families, Pinterest pre-flattens every conversion family x source (WEB/INAPP/OFFLINE) x attribution split (CLICK/ENGAGEMENT/VIEW) x unit (count/_VALUE_IN_MICRO_DOLLAR/_QUANTITY) and the 99-column device-path family (TOTAL_<EVENT>_<DEVICE>_ACTION_TO_<DEVICE>_CONVERSION) directly into the columns enum. The official enum IS the flat catalog.
_derivation.count_divergence: Official async enum 626 (+1 sync-only) vs Supermetrics 465 (321 metrics / 144 dimensions incl. 40 DEPRECATED + 12 system fields). Supermetrics groups device-path and per-source conversion variants under canonical fields with breakdown settings, and counts targeting VALUE permutations as dimensions where the API expresses them as level=*_TARGETING + targeting_types request parameters. The official enum is the authority; Supermetrics is labelling/description enrichment only.
_derivation.sync_async_split: ReportingColumnSync (185) is a strict subset of ReportingColumnAsync except QUIZ_PIN_RESULT_OPEN. Async-only columns (442) are reachable ONLY through POST /ad_accounts/{id}/reports (create -> poll -> download; link valid 5 min, report 1 h). The 184 shared columns carry a 'ReportingColumnSync member' marker in their catalog description.
_derivation.micros_rule: Every *_IN_MICRO_DOLLAR column is an int64 micro-currency amount on the wire and is landed as value/1e6 (platform micros rule). The catalog description of each such column carries the exact marker 'value/1e6'; the connector derives its unit-conversion set FROM that catalog marker (google-ads 26.2 review lesson: catalog-driven, never an id-suffix heuristic in the transform path).

sources._fetch: curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinterest/api-description/main/v5/openapi.json -o /tmp/pinterest-ads-sources/openapi.json   # then build_official_fields.py mirrors components.schemas.ReportingColumnAsync/.ReportingColumnSync enums (the committed tuples are the audited transcription of those enums)

curl -sL https://docs.supermetrics.com/docs/pinterest-ads-fields.md -o /tmp/pinterest-ads-sources/supermetrics.md   # DO NOT COMMIT (enrichment snapshot only). Published totals: 465 fields = 321 metrics / 144 dimensions incl. 40 DEPRECATED; snapshot updated 2026-03-05. Provenance-only in v1: the official descriptions are authored in build_official_fields.py, so no 'file'/'parser' keys here -- a future enrichment pass adds them and re-runs the generator with the local snapshot.

_section_note: Sections are assigned by build_official_fields.py from column-name families (first match wins): device-path *_ACTION_TO_*_CONVERSION -> CONVERSION DEVICE PATH; WEB_SESSION* -> WEB SESSIONS; COLLECTION_PIN_ITEM* -> COLLECTION; TOTAL_VIDEO_*/VIDEO_*/ECPV/ECPCV -> VIDEO; ratio-derived (rates, ROAS, CTR, ECP*, CP*, COST_PER_*, frequency, averages) -> PERFORMANCE; *_VALUE_IN_MICRO_DOLLAR -> CONVERSION VALUE; SPEND_*/ADS_CREDIT_* -> SPEND; impression counts -> IMPRESSION; clickthrough/outbound-click counts -> CLICKTHROUGH; engagement/repin/showcase/quiz counts -> ENGAGEMENT; remaining conversion-event counts/quantities -> CONVERSION; entity-attribute dims -> ENTITY (except PRODUCT_ITEM_* -> PRODUCT ITEM and VIDEO_LENGTH -> VIDEO); 'date' -> TIME. Deviation from the research draft documented: PRODUCT_GROUP_ID / PRODUCT_GROUP_STATUS sit in ENTITY (not PRODUCT ITEM) because PRODUCT_GROUP is a whitelisted catalog_daily level and its grain id must stay exposed. TARGETING and ATTRIBUTION are reserved for the *_TARGETING-level breakdown columns of a future targeting profile (0 fields in v1). Supermetrics sections (CORE METRICS, CONVERSIONS CHECKOUT, ...) would enrich labels only; DEPRECATED/QUERY/DATASOURCE sections are excluded from any merge.

probe.structural_note: Sync-probeable columns (the 184 shared ReportingColumnSync members + QUIZ_PIN_RESULT_OPEN) are probed via GET /ad_accounts/{id}/campaigns/analytics with a comma-joined columns= param over a 1-day window on the selected ad account (granularity=DAY, one known campaign_id); a rejected batch is bisected to capture the exact offending column. ASYNC-ONLY columns (442) cannot be probed by a single GET: the harness must run the create->poll->download report cycle per batch (level=CAMPAIGN, 1-day window) or leave them explicitly unprobed in coverage.unprobed on a tier-core-only pass. 400 responses with body code 12 or a 'Retry after' message are TRANSIENT (retry), never a field rejection.

_request_limits._note: Module-local companion consumed by connector.py at request-build time (validated BEFORE the API call; violations raise typed invalid_request without a provider round-trip). Field-level legality lives in field_compatibility (core schema, below); THESE are the request-parameter limits.
_request_limits._levels_note: level -> data_level landing stamp. The 13 spec levels minus *_TARGETING (need targeting_types), ADVERTISER (account totals, no entity grain v1), PRODUCT_ITEM (operational v1 refusal: dedicated 92/31-day window + forbidden ad columns -- see excluded_sections['PRODUCT ITEM'] and _reserved_product_item) and KEYWORD (review 26.3 F-3: the enum carries NO observable keyword identity column, so N keywords of an ad group would collapse onto one grain key under the QUALIFY supersede -- probe-only ratification, see ROLLOUT_NOTES).

_reserved_hour._note: Granularity HOUR window (8 days back / 3-day range, identical sync and async) -- RESERVED, not wired in v1 (review 26.3 F-8): granularities_supported_v1 = [DAY], nothing reads this block. Documents the provider limit for a future hourly profile.

_reserved_product_item._note: level=PRODUCT_ITEM window (92 days back / 31-day range) -- RESERVED, not wired in v1 (review 26.3 F-4): the level is not whitelisted (_levels_note) and the 11 PRODUCT_ITEM_* columns carry an operational exclusion. Documents the provider limit for a future PRODUCT_ITEM request shape.

attribution_pinned._note: Story 26.3 pinned report spec (API defaults made EXPLICIT so a provider default change can never silently restate our series). Divergence documented: since 2025-04-01 the Ads Manager UI presets dropped the engagement window (UI default = 30 click + 1 view); the API keeps engagement_window_days. Two pulls with different windows are NOT comparable -- the pinned values are stamped into every request and returned in the pull result's attribution metadata (stored on the datastream).

_async_report_lifecycle._status_note: Canonical mapping consumed by the module's poll callable for core.async_reports (26.1): FINISHED -> completed, IN_PROGRESS -> processing, EXPIRED/CANCELLED/DOES_NOT_EXIST -> expired (single resubmission then typed provider_transient), FAILED -> failed (typed provider_transient). DOES_NOT_EXIST maps to expired per the 26.1 F-3 contract: a reference the provider no longer knows must consume the single resubmission, never fail the pull on an orphaned ref.
_async_report_lifecycle._download_note: The download URL returned by the poll is valid 5 MINUTES: the connector downloads IMMEDIATELY after the poll that returned FINISHED (the URL is never persisted for later). A 403 'Request has expired' on the download URL raises core.async_reports.DownloadLinkExpired -> single resubmission.

excluded_sections.PRODUCT ITEM: The 11 PRODUCT_ITEM_* attribute columns are unreachable at any whitelisted v1 level: they only return at level=PRODUCT_ITEM, which v1 refuses operationally (dedicated 92-day/31-day window profile -- _request_limits._reserved_product_item, config not wired -- and the level forbids ad_ids/ad_statuses and every pin-promotion/ad column). Operational v1 refusal, not a deferral.

excluded_fields.QUIZ_PIN_RESULT_OPEN: SYNC-ONLY column (ReportingColumnSync minus ReportingColumnAsync): not requestable through the async report path that catalog_daily uses. Excluded (never planned) until a sync-columns profile exposes the 185-column sync surface; documented in the ROLLOUT_NOTES probe list.

field_compatibility._note: Story 26.3 -- GENERATED by build_official_fields.py (do not edit by hand; regen keeps the rules in lockstep with the enum). Core contract (field-compatibility.schema.json, 26.1): selectable_set rules scoped {'level': <LEVEL>} consumed by core.field_compat.enforce_selection with context={'level': ...} BEFORE any API call. Date-window / granularity limits are request-parameter validation (not field rules): see _request_limits.
field_compatibility._source: POST /ad_accounts/{ad_account_id}/reports endpoint description + per-level response attributes, OpenAPI 5.28.0

rules._note: Columns selectable in an async report at level=AD_GROUP: every async metric + the entity-attribute dimensions of the AD_GROUP lineage + the date grain. QUIZ_PIN_RESULT_OPEN (sync-only) and PRODUCT_ITEM_* attributes are reachable at NO whitelisted level (typed pre-call refusal).

Columns selectable in an async report at level=CAMPAIGN: every async metric + the entity-attribute dimensions of the CAMPAIGN lineage + the date grain. QUIZ_PIN_RESULT_OPEN (sync-only) and PRODUCT_ITEM_* attributes are reachable at NO whitelisted level (typed pre-call refusal).

Columns selectable in an async report at level=PIN_PROMOTION: every async metric + the entity-attribute dimensions of the PIN_PROMOTION lineage + the date grain. QUIZ_PIN_RESULT_OPEN (sync-only) and PRODUCT_ITEM_* attributes are reachable at NO whitelisted level (typed pre-call refusal).

Columns selectable in an async report at level=PRODUCT_GROUP: every async metric + the entity-attribute dimensions of the PRODUCT_GROUP lineage + the date grain. QUIZ_PIN_RESULT_OPEN (sync-only) and PRODUCT_ITEM_* attributes are reachable at NO whitelisted level (typed pre-call refusal).

descriptive_mutable._note: Story 26.6 Part A -- GENERATED by build_official_fields.py (do not edit by hand). Entity STATE/TYPE dimensions that mutate over time for a fixed grain: the connector lands them in attributes_json (latest-wins, HORS partition) instead of segments_json (the QUALIFY supersede grain key), so a refetch re-reading a window with a changed status does not double the window's metrics. Grain-bearing ids and conversion/device-path metrics are NEVER listed here.
